d: On the occasion of Karthigai Deepam, a lamp was lit—as is done every year—on the Tiruparankundram hill in Tamil Nadu. However, instead of being placed on the contentious 'Deepathoon' (lamp pillar), the lamp was lit at the 'Uchi Pillaiyar Mandapam'. This occurred despite the Supreme Court having granted permission for the lamp to be lit on the Deepathoon pillar. Members of various Hindu organizations staged a protest in front of the temple, opposing the decision by the state government to light the lamp at a different location—a move that went against the Supreme Court's order.
